While these intervals account for a wide range of probable outcomes, certain high-impact events could push the actual value beyond these boundaries. Furthermore, "black swan" events – rare, unpredictable, high-impact occurrences like a global pandemic resurgence or a major natural disaster affecting critical economic infrastructure – always possess the potential to cause outcomes far outside typical statistical expectations.
